idea: Price-event clock: two-threshold excursion then one-threshold reversal
status: Research-only mechanical reconstruction; unoptimised raw screen
threshold: 1.0 times Wilder ATR14 of completed M5 bid bars; freeze once per UTC day using only bars completed at or before midnight. Same value for the whole day.
event_sampling: Completed M1 bid closes, not ticks. Intraminute directional-change events may be missed. No optimisation of sampling or thresholds.
long: Track a running high; arm after a decline of at least two thresholds, update the running low, then signal a buy after a recovery of one threshold from that low.
short: Mirror: track running low; arm after a rise of at least two thresholds, then sell after a one-threshold decline from running high.
entry: At next M1 open: ask for buy, bid for sell. Skip if next quote is more than one minute after signal time or structural stop is already invalid.
stop: Long: sampled running bid low minus one price tick. Short: sampled running bid high plus signal-minute spread plus one price tick.
holding: One position per asset; no averaging, trailing, breakeven or ordinary time exit. Study-end remaining positions close at first available quote at/after end within two minutes.
reset: At each UTC day for flat assets; while a position is held ignore entry signals. Start a fresh event after an exit. Blocked/expired signals are consumed, not retried indefinitely.
budget: Freeze 2% of closed balance at UTC day start, reserve carried positions' initial stop risk, subtract initial cash risk of all new positions (not refunded after wins or losses). Reject entries exceeding remaining budget. Also cap four new entries. This is nominal exposure control, not a guarantee of maximum floating or daily loss.
sizing: 0.5% of closed balance at entry, floored to broker lot step, never rounded up to minimum. USD quoted instruments: cash risk = stop price distance times contract size times lots.
execution: M1 bid OHLC and historical per-minute spread. Use only preceding positive spread for missing/zero spread. Stop gaps adversely filled at opening quote, TP gaps conservatively filled at target. Both touched in same minute: primary stop-first, alternative target-first sensitivity. Global sizing happens before intraminute exits to prevent future cash reuse.
costs: Primary includes spread, assumes zero explicit Pro commission and no swap. Swap-free status and historical financing are not verified. Stress adds one extra entry-minute spread round trip plus current non-swap-free rates applied retrospectively at NY17:00 weekday rollover (an assumption, not reconstructed historical fees).
margin_model: Not included. Report maximum gross notional leverage; broker margin changes, minimum stop levels, liquidity, latency and execution rejections are not reconstructed.
combined_case: Run all three simultaneously on one shared account and one shared daily budget; simultaneous entries processed BTCUSD, XAUUSD, USTEC in that frozen order, with exits at opening quote first and later intrabar exits only after entry sizing.
periods: 1y, 6m and 3m, each independent $10,000 start; no candidate selection from these periods.
pipeline: Not a completed pipeline or OOS validation. User's full pipeline requires the final two calendar years; this is the first raw recent-year screen only.
source_note: Intrinsic-time research motivates event sampling; it does not establish profitability of these invented trading rules.
